|errata_history=This is the original (version 1 of 3, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Captain Lando Calrissian (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
* '''Original''' (this page, 9 November 2020): Original: the image at the set's official release (9 November 2020). Players Committee card image, 9 November 2020: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-captainlandocalrissian-20201109.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Captain%20Lando%20Calrissian.gif Holotable commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards”], no mark). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If a battle was just initiated here, may exchange a card in hand with an Interrupt of destiny = 4 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, if you have completed a Kessel Run, may return Lando to hand.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Captain Lando Calrissian (Errata)]], 4 March 2022): Players Committee card image, 4 March 2022: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-captainlandocalrissian-20220304.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d23ce93/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/captainlandocalrissian.png Holotable commit d23ce93 “January 2022 Errata images.”], mark “E1”). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If a battle was just initiated here, may exchange a card in hand with an Interrupt of destiny = 4 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, if you have completed a Kessel Run, may return your Lando to hand.” '''What changed:''' “may return Lando to hand” became “may return your Lando to hand”; re-rendered with art credit “Henry Cheng @ ArtStation” (was “@ Artstation.com”) and the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD”; the card prints the errata mark “E1”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Captain Lando Calrissian (Errata 2)]], 2 January 2023): Players Committee card image, 2 January 2023: 0 side [[:File:V13-L-captainlandocalrissian.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/fba281d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/captainlandocalrissian.png Holotable commit fba281d “Remastered Sets 13 and P, and 1 AI fix.”], mark “E1”). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If a battle was just initiated here, may exchange a card in hand with an Interrupt of destiny = 4 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, if you have completed a Kessel Run, may return your Lando to hand.” '''What changed:''' Remastered: new art (credit “Image via Stable Diffusion”, was “Image courtesy of Henry Cheng @ ArtStation”) and new frame details; the words and the mark “E1” are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
|hatnote=Other versions of this card: [[Captain Lando Calrissian (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Captain Lando Calrissian (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).
